title: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2026
text: RBI/2026-27/45. All NBFCs are advised to update customer due diligence procedures with effect from 01.12.2026. Issued on 20.11.2026.

title: Digital Lending Directions: amendment
text: DOR.CRE.REC.12/03.10.001/2026-27. These Directions apply to all regulated entities including non-banking financial companies with immediate effect. Dated 18.11.2026.

title: UN Security Council sanctions list: entry amended
text: QDi.901 amended: alias added. Financial institutions must screen customers against the updated list. Published 20.11.2026.

title: Foreign Exchange Management (Overseas Investment) Amendment Regulations, 2026
text: FEMA 120(R)/2026-RB. Authorised dealers and entities making overseas investment shall comply from 01.01.2027.

title: Digital Personal Data Protection: guidance for data fiduciaries
text: This guidance is addressed to all data fiduciaries including lending institutions handling personal data of borrowers.

title: Master Circular on Prudential Norms for Urban Co-operative Banks
text: This Master Circular applies only to Urban Co-operative Banks and does not apply to NBFCs.

title: Auction of Government of India Dated Securities
text: The Reserve Bank announces the auction of dated securities on 25.11.2026 for the market borrowing programme.

title: Recruitment of Grade B officers
text: Applications are invited for the post of Grade B officer. Last date to apply is 30.11.2026.

title: Variable Rate Repo auction results
text: Results of the variable rate repo auction conducted on 20.11.2026 under money market operations.

title: Telecom Consumer Protection (Amendment) Regulations, 2026
text: TRAI direction on commercial communications. Telecom service providers shall comply. Issued on 19.11.2026.

title: Scheduled maintenance of the XBRL portal
text: The portal will be unavailable for maintenance on 22.11.2026 from 22:00 to 02:00.

title: Insurance corporate agents: revised commission guidelines
text: These guidelines apply to insurers and insurance corporate agents. Circular IRDAI/2026/77 dated 17.11.2026.
